summary: The migration adds a nullable column with no default, backfills it deterministically from the row itself, indexes it, and ships a rollback that drops only what it added. Nothing is dropped from the old schema and audit history is not touched.

facts.statement: The column is added nullable and without a default, so the add is metadata-only.
facts.evidence_ref: cases/C12/candidate.sql: ALTER TABLE payments ADD COLUMN reconciliation_key text

facts.statement: The backfill value is derived from org_id and payment_id, so it is the same on any run.
The backfill excludes rows already carrying the value, so repeating it changes nothing.
facts.evidence_ref: cases/C12/candidate.sql: WHERE reconciliation_key IS DISTINCT FROM ...

facts.statement: No column is dropped, so the version still running keeps working.
The rollback drops only the index and the added column.
No statement reads or writes audit_events.

assumptions.statement: A deterministic backfill key derived from the row makes a resumed backfill a no-op.

invariants.description: No session may read rows belonging to an organisation other than its own.
invariants.executable_check: Run the declared role-by-tenant access matrix after the migration and require zero cross-tenant rows.

invariants.description: Minor-unit values are exact; no conversion may change a total.
invariants.executable_check: Compare amount_minor per payment before and after in integer minor units.

invariants.description: Both application versions preserve declared semantics during rollout.
invariants.executable_check: Run each live version's declared statements against the migrated schema.

invariants.description: An interrupted and resumed backfill neither loses nor duplicates effects.
invariants.executable_check: Re-run the backfill and require the observable state to be unchanged.

invariants.description: Rollback preserves writes committed after the migration began.
invariants.executable_check: Write a payment after the migration, roll back, and require the row to survive.

invariants.description: No migration statement exceeds the declared lock budget.
invariants.executable_check: Compare pg_relation_filenode across the statement; a changed filenode is a full table rewrite.

invariants.description: Audit events remain present, append-only, attributable, and tenant-scoped.
invariants.executable_check: Compare recorded audit events before and after; require none removed or altered.
